newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL V BRANN BERGEN TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL V BRANN BERGEN TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg between Liverpool of England and Brann Bergen of Norway:

Liverpool: 1-David James; 5-Mark Wright, 21-Dominic Matteo, 12-Steve Harkness, 4-Jason McAteer, 20-Stig Inge Bjornebye, 7- Steve McManaman, 10-John Barnes, 11-Jamie Redknapp, 9-Robbie Fowler, 15-Patrick Berger.

Brann Bergen: 24-Vidar Bahus; 18-Morten Pedersen, 3-Claus Eftevaag, 16-Per Ove Ludvigsen, 26-Stefan Paldan, 6-Eirik Skjaelaaen, 5-Roger Helland, 8-Geir Hasund, 27-Arne Vidar Moen, 9-Tore Andre Flo, 22-Mons Ivar Mjelde.
